uf_tossups.name: UF Election Lab – House toss-up districts

tx_early.name: Texas SOS – early vote by county (final)
tx_early.note: Cumulative in-person + mail early votes through the last day of early voting (Oct 30).

fl_tqv.name: Florida counties – VR Systems Turnout Quick View

tx_dallas.name: Dallas County Elections – live vote center counts
